responsibility: Declares the GIMPLE semantic-comparison framework for IPA identical code folding. It defines helper logging macros plus the ipa_icf_gimple::func_checker and sem_bb interfaces for comparing basic blocks, statements, operands, SSA names, declarations, loops, and polymorphic/type compatibility between candidate functions. It is the API and comparison contract for the GIMPLE equivalence engine implemented in ipa-icf-gimple.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ipa_icf_gimple comparison framework—func_checker, sem_bb, operand-access helpers, and debug/logging macros—that ipa-icf.cc and ipa-icf-gimple.cc use. Unlike gcc/ipa-icf-gimple.cc, it specifies the API and comparison contract, not the actual equivalence algorithms.
